title: Recruitment Generalist
description:
Recruitment Specialist 
 Job Summary 
 Switrus Holidays Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive, organized, and result-oriented Recruitment 
 Specialist to manage end-to-end recruitment activities across its head office and branches. The 
 candidate will be responsible for identifying suitable talent, sourcing candidates, conducting initial 
 screenings, coordinating interviews, and ensuring timely recruitment of qualified employees in 
 line with the company's manpower requirements. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to 
 manage multiple vacancies simultaneously, and a commitment to maintaining a professional 
 candidate experience. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Manpower Planning and Recruitment 
 Coordinate with the HR Manager, Branch Managers, and department heads to understand 
 current and future manpower requirements. 
 Prepare and maintain a recruitment plan based on approved vacancies and business 
 requirements. 
 Manage end-to-end recruitment for sales, operations, ticketing, customer service, 
 administration, finance, and other positions as required. 
 Ensure recruitment activities are completed within the agreed timelines and hiring targets. 
 2. Candidate Sourcing and Screening 
 Source candidates through job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, employee 
 referrals, social media, and other relevant channels. 
 Prepare and publish job advertisements with accurate job descriptions and eligibility 
 criteria. 
 Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on qualifications, experience, 
 communication skills, and job suitability. 
 
 Conduct initial telephonic or online interviews to assess candidates' suitability. 
 Maintain a database of qualified candidates for current and future vacancies. 
 3. Interview Coordination and Selection 

 Schedule interviews with hiring managers and department heads. 
 Coordinate interview arrangements for head office and branch-level vacancies. 
 Follow up with candidates and interviewers to ensure timely completion of the selection 
 process. 
 
 Collect interview feedback and maintain proper recruitment records. 
 Communicate selection, rejection, and offer-related updates professionally. 
 4. Offer Management and Joining Coordination 
 
 Coordinate salary discussions and offer approvals with the HR Manager. 
 Prepare and issue offer letters to selected candidates after obtaining the necessary 
 approvals. 
 
 Follow up with selected candidates regarding offer acceptance, documentation, and joining 
 dates. 
 Coordinate pre-joining formalities and ensure candidates submit the required documents. 
 Monitor offer-to-joining conversion and take appropriate follow-up actions to reduce 
 candidate dropouts. 
 5. Recruitment Reporting and Documentation 
 Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and recruitment records in the 
 HRMS or other approved systems. 
 Prepare periodic recruitment reports covering vacancies, candidates sourced, interviews 
 conducted, offers released, and employees joined. 
 Track recruitment performance, including time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and offer 
 acceptance rate. 
 Ensure recruitment documentation is properly maintained and candidate information is 
 handled confidentially. 
 6. Employer Branding and Recruitment Improvement 
 
 Support employer branding activities and promote Switrus as an attractive workplace. 
 Develop effective sourcing strategies to improve the quality and availability of candidates. 
 Build relationships with colleges, placement agencies, professional networks, and potential 
 candidates. 
 
 Identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency and candidate experience. 
 Qualifications and Experience 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 6+ years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR operations. Relevant 
 recruitment experience will be preferred. 
 Experience in handling end-to-end recruitment for multiple job categories is desirable. 
 Familiarity with job portals, LinkedIn, recruitment databases, and HRMS/ATS platforms. 
 Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, for recruitment tracking and reporting. 
 Required Skills and Competencies 
 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 Strong candidate sourcing, screening, and interviewing skills. 

 Good coordination, negotiation, and follow-up abilities. 
 Ability to manage multiple vacancies and recruitment deadlines. 
 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
 Target-oriented approach with a focus on timely hiring. 
 Professional conduct, confidentiality, and a positive attitude. 
 Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with different branches and 
 departments.

Key Skills: Head hunting,Recruitment management,End To End Recruitment,Talent acquisition,Management,Hunting,Recruitment,Acquisition
